<div class="pvme-exact-guide">

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>general</nowiki></strong><nowiki> natural combat style progression template for players to follow.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 15 April 2026</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="disclaimer"><ins><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="before-looking-here-check-unknown-channel"><nowiki>Before looking here, check </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Priorities can of course change depending on the content being done by the player. You should note that </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>when you upgrade weapons, you can sell the weapon being upgraded</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki> to deduct cost from the new weapon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If an item is not in the order </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>it was deemed not worth buying</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands, </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>the order is subject to change at any time</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Feel free to ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a tailored list for the content that you do!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="early-money-making"><ins><nowiki>Early Money Making</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To make money to fund your first style early on, it is recommended to do either Croesus or easy clue scrolls.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="ranged-upgrade-order"><ins><nowiki>Ranged Upgrade Order</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is a generalised order which assumes a starting point of T70 weapons and armour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For further information on each upgrade check the relevant section in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#armour-and-weapons</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perk-information</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#permanent-unlocks</nowiki></span><nowiki>, or </nowiki><span><nowiki>#eof-specs</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For a checklist version, visit the RS Wiki page at </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order <nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/w/PvM_unlock_guide#Upgrade_order</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If you would like specialised advice, ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
